name: agent-room-desktop
description: Agent Room Desktop shell (Tauri v2): WebView of the web app, tray, local settings page; spawns the Node daemon.

scripts.package: npm run bundle-daemon && node scripts/bundle-node.mjs --platform linux && node scripts/bundle-mcp.mjs && node scripts/assert-mcp-runtime.mjs && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb && node scripts/tarball.mjs
scripts.package:linux: npm run bundle-daemon && node scripts/bundle-node.mjs --platform linux && node scripts/bundle-mcp.mjs && node scripts/assert-mcp-runtime.mjs && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.package:windows: npm run bundle-daemon && node scripts/bundle-node.mjs --platform win && node scripts/bundle-mcp.mjs && node scripts/assert-mcp-runtime.mjs && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.package:all: npm run bundle-daemon && node scripts/bundle-node.mjs && node scripts/bundle-mcp.mjs && node scripts/assert-mcp-runtime.mjs && tauri build
